sentences.text: Goodradigbeeon was an extinct fish belonging to the class Placodermi, a group of armored jawed fishes.
The genus is defined by its type species, Goodradigbeeon australianum, and it belongs to the family Homostiidae.
This genus was first described by White in 1978, based on a holotype specimen found near the Goodradigbee River by Harry A. Toombs.
Goodradigbeeon lived during the Emsian stage, between 410.62 and 393.47 million years ago.
